name: Elixir of Suffering
summary: In Tarren Mill, Apothecary Lydon pursues lethal brews against the living. He turns to travelers for animal reagents from the surrounding foothills.

sections.title: A Toxic Enterprise
sections.body: Tarren Mill is both a Forsaken stronghold in the Hillsbrad Foothills and a research station for the Royal Apothecary Society. Apothecary Lydon works there amid the green countryside, which he despises. He longs to see human settlements poisoned and conquered. To make his experimental Elixir of Suffering, he needs potent, virulent ingredients from nearby creatures.

sections.title: Gathering Reagents
sections.body: Apothecary Lydon sends hunters into the wilds around Tarren Mill for Gray Bear tongues and the rare ichor of Moss Creepers. Unholy alchemy refines these animal substances into the basis of a lethal mixture. He intends it to kill living trespassers across Hillsbrad.

faq.answer: Apothecary Lydon is a member of the Royal Apothecary Society stationed in Tarren Mill. He despises Hillsbrad's living landscape and works to make potent poisons against human populations.

faq.q: Why does Lydon need bear tongues and creeper ichor?
faq.answer: Apothecary Lydon needs Gray Bear tongues and Moss Creeper ichor as ingredients for his lethal brews. Their biological properties provide the alchemical base for his Elixir of Suffering.

faq.q: Where does this quest lead next?
aliases: what happens after elixir of suffering
faq.answer: After Apothecary Lydon receives the ingredients, he blends them into a prototype brew and demands that it be tested on living subjects for its lethal effect.

faq.q: What is the goal of the Royal Apothecary Society in Hillsbrad?
faq.answer: The Royal Apothecary Society, under Lady Sylvanas Windrunner's command, seeks an alchemical plague that can wipe out humanity and the Scourge alike. Tarren Mill is a frontier outpost for gathering biological matter and testing prototypes against local Alliance forces.

faq.q: Where can the necessary creatures be found?
faq.answer: Gray Bears roam the central fields and forests of the Hillsbrad Foothills. Moss Creepers lurk in brush and wooded areas just outside Tarren Mill.

faq.q: Why is Lydon in such a bad mood?
faq.answer: Apothecary Lydon is disgusted by vitality, clean air, and thriving nature. He finds joy in death, decay, and distilling deadly toxins.

angles.text: As a Forsaken operative, you can help advance the Royal Apothecary Society's aim to create a devastating weapon for your people's survival against living humanity.
As a Horde ally, you may balk at the Forsaken's ruthless biological experiments. Tarren Mill's frontier against Southshore depends on their alchemical warfare.
